implementation_change: DuckDB computes two hidden 32-byte SHA-256 record digests per output row.
Hidden instrumentation columns are stripped before the visible result and result digest are constructed.
Python assembles the fixed 64-byte edge payload and independently verifies it from visible keys.
integrity_gates: All paired direct and record-lineage result digests must agree.
All V3 evidence artifacts must pass independent recomputation.
No hidden instrumentation column may appear in the user-visible result.
Artifact storage must remain approximately 64 bytes per record edge.
decision_policy: V3 remains a bounded development pilot and is not paper performance evidence.
Advance to formal 100K/500K record-lineage scaling only if V3 preserves integrity and materially lowers V2 capture cost.
A slower or equivalent V3 result is retained as a negative result and does not authorize threshold tuning.
